review.why: Upgrades a dbt 1.3 to 1.7 project to 1.12 using a precompiled issue bundle: replays version boundaries and pins behavior flags the project actually uses.
review.summary: Two mechanisms: replay each breaking change up to 1.8, and after 1.8 pin the behavior-change flag only for behaviors the project shows. Issues come from a precompiled bundle and are handled by type (deterministic, agentic, human, behavior flag), with advisory-only environment changes and a rule to never invent issues. Execution profiles differ for local and platform use.
strengths: Data-driven: it never fabricates an issue or a fix from memory
Human-type issues need explicit confirmation before applying
Pins only the flags a project exhibits, avoiding dead config
cautions: Tied to specific dbt versions and adapters
Needs the compiled bundles and execution profile files, not read here
Large knowledge base of 50 issue files not read here
